name: join-code
title: Join Code
description: How people get into a live room: the address to visit, a code to type there, and a QR code that does both in one scan. Built for the host's big screen first (`size="stage"`), and just as usable on a phone that wants to pass the room on, with a copy-link…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/join-code

Installed to `components/ui/games/join-code.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/join-code';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/join-code

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
